meta.title: Fix file save blocking on entry refresh for improved hot reload performance
meta.body_summary: Make refresh_entry non-blocking during file save to reduce hot reload detection latency; moves the refresh to a background task so save returns immediately after disk write.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code produced a 28-line async fix for hot reload save latency; PR self-closed after CLA bot comment, with no human review or performance testing.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 28 changed lines in a single file, this is a tiny edit. As a narrowly scoped performance fix, it was closed, not merged, despite being small, likely due to CLA process rather than technical rejection.

review_details.concern_detail: The cla-bot flagged missing CLA sign-off; the author self-closed the PR minutes later without addressing it or awaiting review.
review_details.performance_claim: Making refresh_entry non-blocking returns save success immediately, so hot reload tools detect file change sooner.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by author after CLA bot comment, no maintainer engagement; likely abandoned due to CLA or self-realized issue.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Small technical fix feasible by agent, but blocked by external CLA requirement and no review engagement, resulting in immediate self-close.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler evidence; only narrative claim in PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regression cycle.

core_change_summary.description: In crates/worktree/src/worktree.rs, modified write_file to detach the refresh_entry call, returning immediately after file write rather than awaiting the refresh.
change_trajectory: Single commit made the refresh non-blocking by spawning it as a detached task.
